title: Crest
notes: A wave-like form cast in Jesmonite: smooth, stone-like and pale, made to stand outdoors in all weathers.

title: Tryst
notes: Two figures in conversation: a Corten silhouette leaning into an open lattice of welded steel. Over three metres tall.

title: Suzanne
medium: Bronze, cast in the artist's own foundry
notes: Cast by Michael in his own foundry: lost-wax, silicon bronze, poured by hand. The film on the Sculpture page follows it from wax to finished bronze.
